decisions.id: W55-1 grove topped up to 0080's density as drawn
decisions.summary: a non-conifer-led clump keeps throwing until its drawn crowns hold its open ground (open_share) at GROVE_CROWN_SQFT, or TOPUP_TRIES x want throws fail; m:wave55-grove-density-as-drawn (Mizuguchi 339 -> 601 crowns)
decisions.why: Brings the drawn map to 0080's one crown per ~180 sq ft, which is what the request asks: the implementation matching the referenced research. The density is measured over open ground because 0080's figure is for wooded ground, not keep-out ground. TOPUP_TRIES is a search breadth labeled NONE, not a cap below the research. The homestead grove's glyph-check round 2 is owed and declared in tasks.md Occasions.
